replies.author: EncryptedShoesHD
replies.body:
Socks. 

So javi, 

I met you on avicus a while ago, my first thoughts on you were like,  "This kid could be a fun person to talk to.".  After a lot of thinking I finally decided to talk to you. I can tell I really enjoyed our conversations, even on TeamSpeak. Back, when I was a mod, I knew you're the one who I can trust even when I have problems, in game or in real life. For me, you were always like the closest person I could talk to. You always responded to my messages within one or two hours and you were always willing to help me. Unfortunately I retired for some time, but I hope we can still talk as much as we used to. Keep up the good work, you deserve your position!
